review_method: 2-second full-timeline frame sampling; dense samples around selected joins; central-region motion diagnostic at 2fps; full decode, metadata, final-audio transcription and loudness. Continuous audiovisual playback and subjective listening were not established.

original.interpretation: Locate passages for review. Movement may be caused by footage, graphics, cuts, noise, or camera moves; it is not a quality score.
